subject: Interview Availability — Senior Backend Engineer
body:
Dear TrustHR Hiring Team,

Thank you for reaching out regarding my application for the Senior Backend Engineer position. I am very enthusiastic about this opportunity.

I confirm my availability for the technical round during any of these windows:
- Tuesday, Nov 3 between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM UTC
- Wednesday, Nov 4 between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM UTC
- Thursday, Nov 5 from 9:00 AM UTC onwards

Please let me know which time slot suits the engineering panel.

Best regards,
Amira Ben Salah
